text: こいつは　つかまりそうにないぞ！

structure.jp: つかまりそうにないぞ！
structure.en: doesn't look like it'll be caught!

patterns.name: 〜そうにない
patterns.explanation: そうにない after a shortened verb means 'doesn't look like it will happen'. つかまりそうにない = 'doesn't look like it will get caught'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.span: つかまりそうにないぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, forceful 'I'm telling you'. つかまりそうにないぞ = 'it's not going to get caught, I tell you'.
